response.sql: SELECT AVG(TG) AS avg_TG, AVG(WBC) AS avg_WBC FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC >= 6.5

assumptions.assumption: AVG(TG) is computed over only those rows with WBC >= 6.5 that have a non-null TG, while AVG(WBC) averages all rows with WBC >= 6.5; each average ignores its own NULLs independently (the standard AVG behavior).

alternatives.interpretation: Compute both averages over the same set of rows, only those with WBC >= 6.5 and non-null TG, so the two averages are based on identical records.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(TG) AS avg_TG, AVG(WBC) AS avg_WBC FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC >= 6.5 AND TG IS NOT NULL
